# A Lamp to My Feet

> A Lamp to My Feet sells 30-day Scripture email series for women. Each morning at 6 AM (Arizona time), one ESV passage arrives by email with context, reflection, and prayer questions. Each series is a one-time $9 purchase (not a subscription) with a full refund within 3 days, no questions asked.

## Series
- [30 Days of Scripture for Anxiety](https://alamptomyfeet.com/anxiety/): available now, $9 one time. Thirty mornings from Philippians to the Psalms.
- Coming soon: Fear, Grief, Identity, Hope, Healing.

## Articles
- [Bible Verses for Anxiety at Night: Scripture for When You Can't Sleep](https://alamptomyfeet.com/articles/bible-verses-for-anxiety-at-night/): Lying awake with a racing mind? These Bible verses for anxiety at night, rooted in Psalms 3 and 4, show why you can lie down in peace before it all makes sense.
- [What Does the Bible Say About Anxiety? An Honest, Hopeful Answer](https://alamptomyfeet.com/articles/what-does-the-bible-say-about-anxiety/): What does the Bible say about anxiety? Scripture is honest about anxious hearts and offers hope: bring it all to God in prayer, and His peace will guard you.
- [Is Anxiety a Sin? What the Bible Really Says](https://alamptomyfeet.com/articles/is-anxiety-a-sin/): Is anxiety a sin? The Bible shows faithful people in deep distress and calls us to trust, not shame. Here is what Scripture says about worry, faith, and grace.
- [Cast All Your Anxiety on Him: What 1 Peter 5:7 Really Means](https://alamptomyfeet.com/articles/cast-all-your-anxiety-on-him/): What does 'cast all your anxiety on him' mean? Learn the meaning of 1 Peter 5:7, the word Peter chose, and why it begins with humility and ends in God's care.
- [Bible Verses for Anxiety and Overthinking: Scripture for a Racing Mind](https://alamptomyfeet.com/articles/bible-verses-for-anxiety-and-overthinking/): Can't stop overthinking? These Bible verses for anxiety and overthinking, from Psalm 139 to Isaiah 26, show how to bring a racing mind into God's presence.
- [Bible Verses About Fear of the Future: Trusting God With What's Ahead](https://alamptomyfeet.com/articles/bible-verses-about-fear-of-the-future/): Afraid of what lies ahead? These Bible verses about fear of the future, including Proverbs 31:25 in context, show why your times are safe in God's hand.
- [Bible Verses for Grief After Miscarriage: Comfort for a Grieving Mother](https://alamptomyfeet.com/articles/bible-verses-for-miscarriage/): Grieving a miscarriage? These gentle Bible verses for grief after miscarriage remind you that your baby was known by God, who is near to the brokenhearted.
- [Bible Verses for Losing a Mother: Comfort When Your Mom Is Gone](https://alamptomyfeet.com/articles/bible-verses-for-losing-a-mother/): Grieving your mom? These Bible verses for losing a mother, from Isaiah 66:13 to John 14, offer real comfort, honest grief, and hope that holds in Christ.
- [Who God Says I Am: Bible Verses About Identity in Christ for Women](https://alamptomyfeet.com/articles/who-god-says-i-am/): Who does God say I am? These Bible verses about identity in Christ for women show what God declares over His daughters: chosen, loved, forgiven, and made new.
- [Jeremiah 29:11 in Context: What “I Know the Plans I Have for You” Really Means](https://alamptomyfeet.com/articles/jeremiah-29-11-meaning/): What does Jeremiah 29:11 really mean? Read in context, it is a promise to exiles in Babylon, and it reveals a God whose plans hold even in the long wait.
- [Psalm 34:18 Meaning: The Lord Is Near to the Brokenhearted](https://alamptomyfeet.com/articles/psalm-34-18-meaning/): What does Psalm 34:18 mean? Read the verse in context, what "brokenhearted" and "crushed in spirit" mean, and how God draws near in grief.
- [Bible Verses for Loneliness: Scripture for When You Feel Alone](https://alamptomyfeet.com/articles/bible-verses-for-loneliness/): Feeling alone? These Bible verses for loneliness, from Psalm 25 to Hebrews 13, show that God sees you, stays with you, and sets the lonely in families.
- [What to Do When God Is Silent: Scripture for the Waiting](https://alamptomyfeet.com/articles/what-to-do-when-god-is-silent/): What should you do when God is silent? Psalm 13, Psalm 22, and the story of Lazarus show how to keep praying, keep waiting, and trust His love.
